status_semantics.ACTIVATED: Functional form is admitted to the empirical model and calibration set. No default parameter is implied; numerical use requires an explicit calibrated/externally sourced parameter bundle.
status_semantics.CANDIDATE: Mechanism is plausible and evidence-linked but not yet admitted to the central calibration model because identification, aggregation or regime stability is insufficient.
status_semantics.REJECTED: Specified shortcut/form is excluded from the scientific model unless new evidence justifies reopening it.
status_semantics.DEFERRED: Mechanism may matter but current observability/identification/scope is insufficient for the empirical-dynamics cycle; it is not numerically active.

mechanisms.functional_form: household_housing candidate: lend[t] = lend[t-1] + beta * (policy[t]-policy[t-1]); no NFC form is selected

parameters.interpretation: Frozen coefficient fitted through 2025-01 for the household housing delta-policy candidate; it remains a candidate parameter because the final holdout contained zero policy-rate changes.

mechanisms.estimation_plan: Do not respecify the frozen household delta-policy form before its first prospective confirmation on genuinely new policy-rate variation. NFC requires a newly preregistered model/data cycle before any form can be selected.
limits: policy-rate endogeneity remains
pass-through may be asymmetric/regime-dependent
new-business rates do not equal effective rates on outstanding stocks
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: the frozen household beta becomes unstable or leaves the preregistered admissible domain in a future independently preregistered cycle
a prospective confirmation window containing genuinely non-zero policy-rate variation fails the frozen predictive gate versus persistence without post-observation respecification
residual dynamics under identifying policy-rate variation reveal systematic omitted lag or regime structure requiring a newly preregistered candidate cycle
no NFC form may be promoted without a new preregistered structural-selection cycle because the previous NFC candidates failed before holdout

validation_recovery_disposition.interpretation: The household delta-policy form passed structural selection but the fresh holdout contained no policy-rate movement and could not distinguish the candidate from persistence. NFC tested forms failed structural selection before holdout. The generic pass-through mechanism therefore remains a candidate and is not an active central feedback.

validation_recovery_nfc.reason: No preregistered NFC candidate passed all structural-selection gates; the final NFC holdout remains unopened.

parameters.interpretation: share of debt stock repriced/refinanced in period

mechanisms.estimation_plan: Do not estimate at the current public-data boundary. Reopen only if same-boundary instrument/block evidence supplies opening outstanding principal, realized repriced/refinanced or reset principal, and matched old/new effective rates sufficient to pass the frozen government repricing-ledger gates. Maturity shares, refixing targets, aggregate financing needs, issue sizes, or one auction yield may not substitute for the missing matched repricing structure.
limits: currency mix and maturity structure matter
cash/ESA interest concepts may differ
market yield is not the same as average issuance cost
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: maturity/refinancing share cannot be bounded from data
implied effective-rate path violates observed interest expenditure beyond declared reconciliation tolerance

validation_recovery_disposition.interpretation: Ledger completeness failed before estimation and the repricing share is not point-identifiable at the current public-data boundary. No synthetic allocation is permitted; the mechanism is deferred.

mechanisms.estimation_plan: Quarterly reduced-form candidate using ESA household consumption/disposable-income data and matched borrowing/debt-service measures; compare with income-only baseline before admission.
limits: fiscal transfers, inflation and confidence can dominate short samples
disposable-income quarterly comparability must be verified
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: rate/debt-service terms practically non-identifiable
does not outperform income-only baseline on untouched evaluation data
coefficient signs unstable across origins

mechanisms.estimation_plan: Quarterly GFCF candidate with financing-cost and EU-fund terms; structural-selection data must be separated from later holdout evaluation.
limits: public and private investment are mixed in aggregate GFCF
EU-funded investment creates large policy-driven variation
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: financing-cost term not identifiable
candidate loses to demand-only baseline out of sample
parameter instability around EU-fund cycles

mechanisms.functional_form: gCredit = alpha + beta_y*gActivity - beta_r*real_lending_rate - beta_npl*NPL + beta_cap*capital_buffer
mechanisms.estimation_plan: Calibration remains closed. First materialize exact sector-specific NFC and household/NPISH credit targets together with realised BNR Bank Lending Survey credit-standards and loan-demand series, plus harmonised NPL and total-capital-ratio state controls under frozen provenance. The current aggregate reduced form is not eligible for estimation as a bank-supply equation because demand and supply are jointly determined. After source materialisation, preregister a sector-specific predictive/identification cycle and untouched holdout; no causal or feedback activation follows from predictive gain alone.
limits: aggregation can reverse bank-level relations
credit demand and supply are jointly determined
prudential-regime changes matter
BNR Bank Lending Survey supply standards and loan demand must remain separate rather than being collapsed into one aggregate credit signal
NPL and total capital ratios are endogenous prudential state variables, not clean exogenous bank-supply shocks
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: demand/supply components cannot be separately or robustly identified
high parameter trade-off
no out-of-sample gain versus autoregressive credit baseline

mechanisms.estimation_plan: Estimate only with an external/global-risk control and time-respecting validation; consider regime/break terms. Do not interpret coefficients causally without stronger identification.
limits: fiscal variables are endogenous to growth and rates
global risk and ratings/news can dominate
low-frequency fiscal data constrain identification
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: fiscal coefficients are not practically identifiable
simple global-risk/persistence baseline performs as well or better out of sample
parameter signs flip across regimes

mechanisms.estimation_plan: Calibration remains closed. First retain exact monthly ECB EXR.M.RON.EUR.SP00.A and Eurostat Romania HICP CP00 source vintages, then resolve the external-price-control coverage gate before freezing the inflation transform, regime start, lag horizon, structural-selection window and untouched evaluation window. Compare any distributed-lag candidate against an inflation autoregression plus an ex-ante external-price baseline. Do not interpret predictive improvement as causal pass-through and do not import pre-current-regime coefficients.
limits: documented regime dependence
energy/tax/import-price shocks confound pass-through
managed-float interventions are endogenous
Romania-specific import-price control coverage must be verified rather than inferred from Eurostat dataset existence
inflation transform and lag horizon must be frozen before untouched evaluation data are opened
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: distributed-lag weights unstable
no gain over inflation autoregression plus external-price baseline
historical coefficient confidence intervals include economically negligible pass-through on current regime

mechanisms.estimation_plan: Require a sufficiently long, definitionally stable NPL series plus debt-service/borrower-risk observables; preferably separate household and NFC risk.
limits: regulatory definitions and portfolio clean-ups can break comparability
aggregate NPL is partly a stock-management outcome
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: no stable comparable NPL history
risk parameters non-identifiable or driven by definitional breaks

mechanisms.functional_form: Delta primary_balance = f(debt_gap, output_gap, institutional/fiscal-package regime)
mechanisms.estimation_plan: Do not impose a Taylor-style fiscal rule during the empirical-dynamics cycle. First encode discrete fiscal packages/institutional regimes and assess whether a stable reaction function exists.
limits: large discretionary packages and EDP constraints create regime shifts
short sample for a stable reaction function
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: reaction coefficients regime-unstable
rule obscures discrete policy measures or performs worse than explicit exogenous fiscal-package representation

mechanisms.functional_form: policy_rate = f(inflation_gap, activity_gap, exchange_rate, expectations, regime)
mechanisms.estimation_plan: Treat the policy rate as observed/exogenous for early empirical validation; estimate a reaction function only with explicit policy-regime and endogeneity treatment.
limits: simultaneous response to endogenous macro conditions
managed-float and intervention channel
policy regime changes
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: cannot identify policy shocks or stable regime-specific coefficients

mechanisms.functional_form: FX debt-service burden = f(currency-specific debt stock, FX move, maturity/refinancing schedule)
mechanisms.estimation_plan: Require currency- and maturity-resolved external/public/private debt exposures before activation.
limits: aggregate F4/F3 stocks are insufficient to infer currency exposure
hedging is unobserved in aggregate accounts
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: currency/maturity exposure cannot be observed or bounded without synthetic allocation

mechanisms.estimation_plan: None in this form. Any future FX equation must include external rates/risk and address simultaneous policy/exchange-rate determination.
limits: direct bivariate shortcut confounds global risk, intervention and endogenous policy response
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: rejected by construction for insufficient causal/structural specification

mechanisms.estimation_plan: None in this form. Risk modelling requires debt service, income/cash flow, collateral/capital and regime variables.
limits: stock size alone does not identify repayment capacity or bank credit risk
rejection_or_degradation_criteria: rejected by construction for omitted repayment-capacity and balance-sheet channels
